decisions.decision: Stop waiting for Adi to forward the email. Detect the grant yourself through the API. Once a day, use the live Tantra Centre S2S app (T-224, zoom_s2s_enc) to call GET /users/me/settings and GET /accounts/me/settings, and GET /meetings/87002851906. Look for [redacted] and disable_participant_video, and log what you find in this task each time. When either field appears and can be set, Zoom has granted it. Then open the admin at https://revops-centre.growthcluborg.workers.dev/admin/enter?k=<key> (key in ~/.config/tantra/revops-admin-key), go to Cohort Settings, set Zoom Support locks to Granted, and press Re-apply room settings. Run Check in Zoom on 87002851906 and on next week's meeting, record the result, and mark the task done. Until then, T-226 Live Control keeps mute-all, no self-unmute and no video in scope as the default, so the 14 Oct cohort is covered either way. Delete the 'Asked of Adi' line.
